result.title: Reproducible Evaluation as the Substrate for Safe Prompt Compression in Production Agents
result.comment: 8 pages (4 pages main text plus references and appendices), 1 table. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild
result.summary: Evaluating conversational agents that act on live, mutable enterprise data is hard: replayed sessions drift as backend state changes, and a benchmark built today can silently go stale as the data it describes moves on. We present an offline evaluation harness for a production conversational agent that stays reproducible despite the live data it operates on changing, and that can be regenerated on demand once it goes stale. We then use this harness as the fitness function for GEPA-based prompt optimization under a correctness gate that guards against reward hacking. Applied to a production merchant-facing agent, correctness-gated compression shrinks the agent's full prompt surface by 3.5-7.6% without regressing held-out task correctness, consistently across three independent subject-model families, and for one, correctness measurably improves.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向生产对话代理的离线评测装置：在后端数据持续变动时保持可复现，并可在基准失效后按需重建；再以此作为 GEPA prompt 优化的适应度函数，配合正确性门控抑制 reward hacking，使 prompt 体积压缩 3.5–7.6% 且不损留出集正确性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「正确性门控下的压缩式优化」与可重建评测思路，可能为 latent 推理训练中避免奖励劫持和信息坍缩提供评测与监督线索，但属纯文本生产代理场景，迁移性需核查。
